title: Sovra.fm launch (Stop. You've been listening to music wrong.)
arc: problem -> meet -> features -> cta: a player is stopped, the pain is named in a pill that swaps its word (songs -> feeds -> loops) and swells into rings, the product is introduced by a prompt box, one create flow shows the whole value (type, create, original track, a DJ that talks), a user-upload feature, then the brand sign-off.
world: Near-black ground with deep violet gradient light that rises as the film turns from pain to product, glass UI cards and pills, one purple accent plus glow, a small white sans for lines; real product UI (queue, prompt box, progress ring, album art, upload pill) is the scenery.
actor: The pill/orb: first the player pill with ribbon, then the 'Same ...' pill that swaps words and swells into rings, then a glowing orb character (two eye dashes) that listens and talks, then the purple dot inside 'broadcast'. A white cursor acts the interactions.

lines.show: A multi-colour ribbon (orange to violet) streaks diagonally across a dark frame and draws behind a small player pill (art, title 'ice', tiny play controls); the ribbon is the music line the pill rides.
lines.handoff: The pill's art tile scales up into a large app icon (eye art) while the word enters at the right.

lines.show: 'Stop' grows in purple at the right of the enlarged player tile (art of an eye); the eye art is large and stares back; the word is held.
lines.handoff: 'Stop' fades, the eye tile stays at the left, and the next sentence appears at the right in dim text.

lines.show: Dim text 'You've been' appears right of the tile; the purple wash starts to build in the background.
lines.handoff: The next two lines stack under it in dim grey, ready to be highlighted.

lines.show: The stacked lines 'listening to music' and 'wrong' sit dim; a highlight sweeps in turn: 'been', then 'listening to music', then 'wrong' lights brighter, the way a lyric would be read; the eye tile at the left watches.
lines.handoff: The tile is replaced by a grey, blurred portrait album cover on a blue field.

lines.show: A soft-focus portrait card on a blue-light ground; a label 'Daily Mix' types in blue, then '01', then '1M+ Followers / 65 Tracks'; a cursor arrives and presses.
lines.handoff: The card splits into a fan of many identical-looking cards sliding sideways.

lines.show: Daily Mix 01..06 cards fan out in a row as the cursor drags the carousel, each card the same grey face in a different tint, the active card lifts and the others dim.
lines.handoff: The carousel is pushed left to make room for the line.

lines.show: 'Forced' then 'Forced onto' then 'Forced onto you' types at the right of the carousel while the cursor drags a card; the word 'you' lands as a card is pressed.
lines.handoff: Everything wipes to violet and the queue panel opens.

lines.show: A 'Queue' panel appears on violet: a list of rows (Rock that, Late Night Static, Midnight Algorithm, Soft Violence, Conciousness, Velvet Collision) each with art, title and a play button; the list scrolls up past the top edge showing the same songs again.
lines.handoff: The list fades and a single outlined pill remains where a row was.

lines.show: A pill outlined in violet appears with 'Same songs'; a music-note chip attaches to its right, the outline fills with violet gradient.
lines.handoff: The pill holds; only its word changes.

lines.show: The pill holds its shape while the word swaps in place: 'songs' blurs out and 'feeds' lands, the pill grows slightly and gets a gloss highlight; a small music-note chip moves to its corner.
lines.handoff: Word swaps again in the same pill.

lines.show: The word swaps to 'loops'; the pill outline swells into three nested rings (concentric pills) with small icons (infinity, shuffle) on the corners, growing to fill the frame like a stadium track; the feeling is being trapped inside a loop.
lines.handoff: The rings explode out of frame and a clean line of text takes the dark.

lines.show: On black, 'Now' appears, then 'watch' and a violet 'this' types in; calm, no UI.
lines.handoff: A glass prompt box rises in from the bottom edge of the frame.

lines.show: A dark glass prompt box fades in with placeholder 'Describe your perfect radio station...'; a glowing violet border traces its edge once (left edge up, top edge, right) as a light stroke.
lines.handoff: The cursor caret blinks and the user types.

lines.line: Afro house, sunset rooftop in Bali, smooth vocals
lines.show: The placeholder is replaced by typed text: 'Afro' then the full prompt; as it overflows the box the text scrolls left, a sparkle icon and a violet 'Create' button appear at the bottom right; the box border glow chases around the edge with each phrase.
lines.handoff: The camera zooms in on the Create button and a cursor presses it.

lines.show: Close-up on the sparkle and 'Create' pill; a white hand cursor slides in and clicks; the pill depresses with a glow.
lines.handoff: The pill dissolves into a progress ring.

lines.show: A small ring and the title 'Afro house' appear with a percentage badge; percentage counts 4, 21, 41, 57, 74, 88, 96, 100 while the ring (amber) fills; at 100 the ring and badge turn green with 'Station Generated'.
lines.handoff: The green ring pops open into the album art.

lines.show: A rendered art tile (a face in violet and orange pattern) fades up with a violet glow behind it, then slides left to reveal a silver vinyl behind it.
lines.handoff: The vinyl disc pulls out of the sleeve as a word appears.

lines.show: 'Original' then 'Original tracks' types right of the sleeve and vinyl; the vinyl slowly turns; the art lifts with a glow.
lines.handoff: Sleeve and disc dissolve, words reflow.

lines.show: 'Never', 'existed' and 'before' pop in on three separate offset baselines as three glowing words, then settle onto a single line; the glow fades as they align (the idea of something new being built).
lines.handoff: A soft violet orb with two vertical dash eyes rises from below.

lines.show: A violet glossy orb with two small dash eyes floats over a floor shadow, blinks once; it is the host.
lines.handoff: The orb stays at left; its line types out at the right.

lines.line: a DJ talking like it's real
lines.show: 'a DJ' in violet then 'talking like' then 'it's real' wrapped on a second line, typed beside the orb; the orb's eyes squash to dots in sync with 'talking'.
lines.handoff: Three coloured ribbons enter the frame to weave around the orb.

lines.show: Three ribbon strands enter in sequence - orange ribbon labelled 'Talking' from the right, violet 'Reacting' from the left, teal 'Flowing' from below - each with a glass tag riding the strand; the three braid around the orb which looks from side to side, then recedes.
lines.handoff: Everything drops away; a photo card slides to the upload line.

lines.show: A portrait photo card of a singer appears with a hand cursor grabbing it; a tiny tag labelled with song info at its left edge; the card drags to the right.
lines.handoff: The card is dragged into a pill.

lines.show: A white outlined pill '+ Upload' sits to the right; the dragged card slides toward it; the pill fills violet as the card hits it, splashing a liquid highlight, text turns to '+ Uploading'.
lines.handoff: The pill collapses to a dot that becomes the 'o' in 'vibe'.

lines.show: 'Your vibe' types in small white; a small orb with music notes is seated between 'Your' and 'vibe' (it takes the word's slot); the orb pulses.
lines.handoff: The word 'vibe' is swapped in place for 'energy' as the orb bursts.

lines.show: 'vibe' is replaced by 'energy' and a violet bloom swells behind the line, filling the frame with glow, then draining out to the left.
lines.handoff: The glow clears to leave three app icons.

lines.show: Three rounded icons - Spotify, Apple Music, queue - sit in a row with a hand cursor; the cursor taps a red x badge on each, which pops it off the row one by one (the old apps are being removed), the last icon glows violet.
lines.handoff: The last icon blooms to violet and a sentence starts.

lines.show: 'It's' appears, a small violet orb icon drops into the line, then 'broadcast' types after it; the orb icon is the visual stand-in for 'your'.
lines.handoff: The sentence tightens upward and a three-line stack slides in beneath.

lines.show: 'Instant', 'Original', 'Hyped' stack on three lines on a grey gradient; a highlight steps downward through them in sequence, each in turn glows white while the others dim.
lines.handoff: The stack collapses to centre and the brand mark appears.

lines.show: A round logo glyph and 'SOVRA.FM' in white and violet appear centred on black.
lines.handoff: A caret types under the wordmark.

lines.show: A small line under the wordmark types 'Type it' with a violet caret; it blinks.
lines.handoff: The tagline's verb is replaced in place.

lines.show: 'Type it' is replaced by a violet play triangle and 'Stream it' (typed with a caret), the verb swapping in the same slot; the logo holds to the end.
lines.handoff: End hold.

techniques: pill holds while its word swaps (songs -> feeds -> loops) and swells into nested rings
product UI as scenery (queue, prompt box, progress ring, upload pill)
highlight sweeps through a dim line to read it
orb character that listens and talks
ribbons labelled with attributes braiding round the actor
glow border traces a box edge
verb swapped in place at the sign-off (Type it -> Stream it)
lessons: Open on the stopped thing: a player pill with a ribbon says 'Stop' before any words do.
Make the problem a pill that holds its shape while one word changes (songs, feeds, loops); then let the outline itself swell into rings to show 'trapped in a loop'.
Show one user flow end to end in the real UI (prompt, create, progress, art) instead of a feature list; each UI state carries one line of copy.
Give the product a character (the orb) and attach its attributes as labelled ribbons that braid around it.
Dim a stacked line and highlight word by word so the line reads like lyrics.
Close on the logo and swap one verb in place (Type it -> Stream it): the CTA is the same element with a new word.
